model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" for six different model configurations across various language families. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "family", and displays nine groups ordered from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, grouping the Indo-European ("IE-") families together first. The vertical axis evaluates the value, labeled "effect", using a linear scale that displays numeric tick labels at 0, 10, 20, and 30, with horizontal grid lines appearing at these regular intervals of 10; the observable values and their error extensions span a range from roughly -5 to 35. Within each category on the horizontal axis, there is a clustered set of six differently colored vertical bars representing distinct components defined by a legend on the right: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The bars vary significantly in height across the families. The tallest bar overall represents the mBERT-B₂ configuration in the IE-Indic family, reaching an approximate value of 24. Conversely, several categories feature bars that dip below the zero baseline, with the lowest negative effect seen in the mBERT-R₂ bar within the Semitic family at roughly -2. The Isolate and Uralic families exhibit the shortest bars overall, with all six model configurations hovering very close to zero. Every bar in the chart is visually emphasized with a black outline and includes vertical black error bars with top and bottom caps to indicate data variability.
